import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
root = pathlib.Path('products/actors/csv-preflight')
files = ['src/__init__.py', 'src/core.py', 'src/public_http.py', 'tests/run_tests.py']
command = [sys.executable, 'tests/run_tests.py']
result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
report = {'scope': 'Offline CSV core baseline rerun with the imported module included', 'cwd': str(root), 'command': command, 'python_version': sys.version.split()[0], 'input_sha256': {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files}, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr}
out = pathlib.Path('products/services/nlnet-open-call-fit/csv-core-baseline-rerun.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
